failure_modes.trigger: Balance-sheet stocks do not share one cutoff-safe measurement date.
Balance-sheet stocks do not use the model currency and unit.
Reported equity does not establish whether NCI or preferred claims are included.
Reported liabilities are added wholesale to NFO after component classification.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject reformulation as a duplicated claim set.

failure_modes.trigger: One root account is assigned to more than one operating, financing, equity, or non-common role.
A missing claim is constructed as the balance-sheet residual.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Record by-construction only and prevent readiness promotion.

failure_modes.trigger: Beginning/ending stocks and owner-flow period do not align.
Net income substitutes for comprehensive income attributable to common owners.
Issuance or SBC owner contribution uses the distribution sign.
Net distributions are fabricated as the clean-surplus residual.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Never label the control independent or promote readiness.

failure_modes.trigger: A dev2 Bundle or mapping result is accepted under the dev3 component lock without replay.
Review coverage is complete but a selected Finding is blocked or provisional.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Keep accounting-quality readiness partial or blocked.

failure_modes.trigger: An uncleared confirmed red flag is represented as resolved.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Emit a material unresolved quality issue.

failure_modes.trigger: Finding severity directly creates an adjustment amount or valuation discount.
MethodAdjustment amount is caller-authored rather than round-tripped from a derived Fact.
Adjustment amount Fact is raw or has incomplete lineage.
Derived adjustment combines sources the fixed ledger cannot express audibly.
R&D or brand capitalization requires an analyst-selected life or amortization period.
Adjustment targets historical operating profit, NOPAT, SBC expense, or another unconsumed kernel field.
Method adjustment has direct or transitive market lineage.
One economic root is consumed by more than one adjustment group.
The same economic claim is deducted in NFO, MethodView, or bridge without registered sharing policy.
Research code imports a private kernel pipeline helper.
Fewer or more than the exact nine bridge roles are present.
Caller supplies a resolved bridge state without replayed policy evidence.
Narrative absence or completed search becomes a numeric zero.
N/A has a Claim but no mappable official numeric Fact for kernel evidence.
One role emits multiple modeled Facts rather than one registered aggregate.
A bridge aggregate combines incompatible formal source lineages.
Option/SBC roots are consumed by both diluted shares and a bridge item.
Two bridge roles share a transitive root Fact.
All roles are absent/N/A and a zero item is fabricated to satisfy kernel minItems.
All cash is automatically classified as nonoperating without reviewed evidence.
A Phase 5B routing boolean is copied into successor readiness.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Recompute the assessment from Phase 5C evidence.

failure_modes.trigger: Two arbitrary dates or an unreviewed Claim establish stable capital structure.
The exact Phase 5B total_liabilities concept is replaced by an unregistered alias.
A dividend, repurchase, issuance, SBC, or other owner component is silently omitted.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Require an explicit coverage decision for all six components.

failure_modes.trigger: Kernel quality issues or gate status do not replay reviewed Finding decisions.
A watch or informational issue is marked resolved rather than nonmaterial/open.
A MethodView bridge adjustment uses a pseudo concept instead of an actual Fact concept and role.
A registered root cannot appear once in each separate method panel.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Apply the one-consumption limit per method, not globally.

failure_modes.trigger: Reordering nested evidence IDs or records changes an internal fingerprint.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Canonicalize all nested sequences and sort records by the full identity key.

failure_modes.trigger: Diluted shares have no root lineage, bypassing overlap checks.
Multiple bridge items reference the same modeled Fact.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Require unique item and Fact identities with one item per modeled role.

failure_modes.trigger: Caller-authored role labels create ready_for_phase5d.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Require the exact method-specific successor role set.

failure_modes.trigger: A reconciliation outside the disclosed tolerance is labeled independent.
The clean-surplus flow starts after its ending date.
Owner-transaction coverage Facts differ from the net-distribution derivation inputs.
A classifiable ledger Fact is omitted from account decisions.
A current Review Finding is omitted from quality compilation.
A compiled adjustment has no registered root-consumption record.
A caller invents a root-consumption channel or economic identity.
A blocked assessment or upstream compilation is shown as a satisfied successor role.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Recompute method panels from closed dependency states.

failure_modes.trigger: A complete bridge references Facts absent from an empty or malformed ledger.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the bridge before compatibility claims.

failure_modes.trigger: Two bridge roles reuse one modeled aggregate Fact.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Require one unique modeled Fact per role.

failure_modes.trigger: A bridge with unresolved roles claims kernel request compatibility.
The fixed six-item kernel validation allowlist is expanded without authorization.
Compiler, market, assumption, request/result, valuation, Score, report, PDF, or Publisher surface appears in 5C-0.
A formula role is populated with a Fact whose registered concept is ineligible for that role.
A non-common claim is included in or excluded from reported totals without a human-reviewed Claim and Decision.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Keep the common-equity and NFO perimeter blocked.

failure_modes.trigger: A method-adjustment amount or source uses a nonnumeric, share-count, wrong-currency, wrong-unit, or mismatched-period Fact.
The adjustment amount lacks the registered calculator identity, version, code SHA, deterministic derivation, or zero-Assumption proof.
A validation consumption record names a root absent from the canonical ledger.
A derived alias hides reuse of the same ultimate raw root within one method.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Expand lineage and reject the duplicate economic deduction.

failure_modes.trigger: A bridge assertion changes the reviewed role-decision rationale while retaining its IDs.
A manufactured derived zero is presented as an official numeric absence Fact.
A derived alias hides overlap between diluted shares and an option or SBC bridge claim.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Expand lineage and reject the bridge fragment.

failure_modes.trigger: A modeled aggregate retains the registered parents but its magnitude does not equal their deterministic sum.
An additional compiler, writer, market, or other Python module is added outside the two approved Phase 5C policy modules.
A reconciliation difference is caller-authored rather than recomputed from bound role Facts.
A Finding fingerprint, status, final severity, or evidence state is changed while retaining a favorable quality disposition.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Recompute the closed Finding mapping and reject drift.

failure_modes.trigger: A MethodView adjustment consumes the same ultimate raw root as its target Fact.
One method contains more than one compiled adjustment for the same category and target Fact.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the duplicate kernel MethodView key.

failure_modes.trigger: One method contains more than one compiled adjustment for the same adjustment group and target Fact.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the duplicate economic group-target key.

failure_modes.trigger: An aggregate account and one of its underlying components enter the same accounting role or formula set.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the classification and formula rather than counting both claim representations.

failure_modes.trigger: The bridge adds a raw Fact, zero-evidence Fact, or source after the MethodView evidence set was frozen.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the bridge and require reconciliation, quality, and MethodView replay with the new evidence.

failure_modes.trigger: Different Fact IDs or aliases represent one exact disclosed economic claim across MethodView, bridge, or diluted shares.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Resolve deterministic economic-claim identity and reject duplicate consumption; block when identity cannot be closed.

failure_modes.trigger: Project method-specific quality readiness differs from the pinned kernel global gate and actual route effect.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Record method execution incompatibility and prohibit market access, request compilation, and kernel execution for the mismatched method.

failure_modes.trigger: Stable-capital readiness uses placeholder IDs or omits the typed FootnoteReview, CapitalAllocationReview, Claim, Candidate, or human Decision chain.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Keep the assessment blocked until the typed evidence objects and exact unions replay.

failure_modes.trigger: The Phase 5C source allowlist is modified, deleted, renamed, or expanded beyond the two authorized internal modules.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Fail source-boundary verification and the exact-head audit.

failure_modes.trigger: The Phase 5C-0 closeout record, accepted state, source commit tree, CI runs, audit identity, or Skill authorization does not match the recorded evidence.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the closeout and keep Phase 5C-1 unauthorized.

failure_modes.trigger: The audit manifest omits a changed file or a static boundary-control file from its recorded hashes.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the audit artifact as incomplete.

failure_modes.trigger: Economic identity, scope, security class, dilution treatment, or root semantics change without a matching reviewed Candidate and Decision.
An unresolved economic-claim identity or dilution treatment is retained while accounting reconciliation claims pass.
A positive option claim already included in diluted shares remains in Penman NFO or is modeled again in the bridge.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject duplicate treatment and require exact not-applicable bridge proof.

failure_modes.trigger: A not-applicable bridge role cites Claim or Decision IDs that do not exactly match its reviewed economic binding.
Two bindings represent the same reviewed economic-event key even when their Fact IDs differ.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reject the duplicate economic claim before method or bridge consumption.

failure_modes.trigger: A missing account role causes another role with confirmed evidence to be labeled unresolved.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Preserve confirmed sibling evidence while blocking only the missing role and dependent formula.

failure_modes.trigger: A mapped Phase 5B ledger Fact no longer matches the frozen ResearchBundle graph value, period, unit, concept, or source locator.
Any market-reference document or snapshot appears anywhere in the Phase 5C validation graph.
A 52/53-week annual chain has an invalid duration, gap, overlap, calendar change, or comparative link but is accepted as three comparable years.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Keep stable-capital evidence blocked while accepting only a fully consecutive valid chain.

failure_modes.trigger: A mapped Phase 5B derived Fact retains its ID and locator while value, concept, unit, category, source, period, currency, confidence, parents, derivation, raw status, or bridge role is altered.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Reconstruct every derived field from the registered CalculationResult, parents, periods, policy, and fingerprints, then reject any mismatch.

failure_modes.trigger: A mapped output or closure decision is removed, reclassified, assigned a different reason, or supplemented by a closure-external decision.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Replay the canonical ledger and exact Decision tuple from the frozen Bundle closure, then reject any byte or set mismatch.

failure_modes.trigger: A self-consistent Phase 5B classification, specialist route, routing assessment, or method panel differs from deterministic replay on the current graph and mapping.
failure_modes.fail_closed: Recompute Phase 5B method readiness and require the complete canonical payload and fingerprint to match.
